overlay.title: In-game overlay
overlay.openHint: Open an output-axis prompt that can be overlaid on the game
overlay.loadFailed: Failed to read the exported rotation
overlay.noProject: Open a project in the desktop editor, then export its overlay.
overlay.emptyTitle: This rotation has no actions yet
overlay.emptyHint: Add actions in the editor and select Overlay again. This window plays exported snapshots.

auto.title: Screen timer trigger (experimental)
auto.hint: Show the game timer and move the HUD or other obstructions away. Select a fixed feature such as its colon or border on the HUD display, then save and monitor.
auto.pauseFirst: Load a rotation and pause the HUD first.
auto.behavior: Starts once when the reference is confirmed, skipping the extra delay. If already visible, waits for it to disappear first. Arm again for each attempt.
auto.restartNeeded: Quit and restart the desktop app to enable screen monitoring.

overlay.desktopHint: Drag to move the window · Ctrl+Alt+O click-through · Ctrl+Alt+Q quit
overlay.desktopKeys: Ctrl+Alt+Space play/pause · Ctrl+Alt+Home reset and pause · Ctrl+Alt+←/→ adjust 0.25s
overlay.shortcutsUnavailable: Some playback shortcuts are unavailable. Use the controls; see desktop startup logs for conflicting keys.
overlay.exportFailed: Overlay export failed. Wait for the current simulation and try again.
overlay.exportChanged: The rotation changed during export. Select Overlay again.
overlay.pendingExport: New rotation exported; pause to load it

settings.title: Overlay settings
settings.showBasicHint: Also show basic attacks / dive / finisher on the belt
settings.startDelayHint: Wait before each start from the beginning. Changes apply on the next restart. Resetting pauses playback; existing preparation actions are preserved.
settings.hint: After editing, select Overlay again to export the updated plan.
settings.fullscreenHint: Exclusive fullscreen covers every window: switch the game to borderless/windowed fullscreen so the overlay can stay on top.

storage.invalidSnapshot: The overlay snapshot format has changed. Export it again from the editor.

input.hint: Default attack: left mouse button or controller X. A tap matches at most one attack; holding repeats with at least 0.35 seconds between successful matches. Feedback confirms input matching, not an in-game cast. Ultimate triggers after holding for 0.2 seconds, without releasing.
input.unavailable: Input monitoring is unavailable on this system

practice.hint: Press Start, then the matching input to advance one step without a timing limit. Actions appear in one evenly spaced row. Hidden basic or heavy attacks are excluded from the sequence and input matching. Holding attack advances consecutive attacks. Unsupported inputs such as dodges are omitted.

desktop.dataDirectoryUnavailable: The portable data directory is not writable. Move the application folder to a writable location.
desktop.displayMissing: The selected display is disconnected. Select the region again.
desktop.displayChanged: Display resolution, scaling, or rotation changed. Select the region again.
desktop.referenceUnreadable: The saved reference image could not be read.
desktop.configurationInvalid: The saved configuration is invalid or the display changed. Select the region again.
desktop.regionInvalid: The region is invalid or too small. Select at least 16 × 8 pixels.
desktop.regionEmpty: The selected region has no image. Select it again.
desktop.lowContrast: The region has too little contrast. Include the timer digits, colon, or border.
desktop.saveRegionFailed: The reference region could not be saved. Select it again.
desktop.captureDenied: The display could not be captured. Check screen recording permissions.
desktop.captureInvalid: The captured display image is invalid. Arm monitoring again.
desktop.captureFailed: Screen capture failed. Check permissions and arm monitoring again.
desktop.clearFailed: The saved configuration could not be deleted. Check data directory permissions.
desktop.displayUnreadable: The current display could not be read.
desktop.displaySizeInvalid: The current display dimensions are invalid.
desktop.pickerImageAlt: Frozen image of the current display
desktop.pickerAreaLabel: Drag to select the timer region
desktop.pickerHeading: Drag to select the game timer · Enter confirms · Esc cancels
desktop.pickerHelp: This is a frozen image of the HUD display. Select fixed features such as a colon or border. Changing digits affect matching; this does not read the timer value.
desktop.pickerLoadFailed: The image could not load. Cancel and try again.
desktop.pickerExpired: The image is no longer available. Cancel and try again.
